title: anthemis rosea subsp. carnea
intro: Anthemis rosea subsp. carnea, commonly known as Pink Chamois or White Chamois, is a plant species in the daisy family (Asteraceae) that has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. This plant is known for its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, wounds, and infections, making it a valuable remedy for promoting wound healing and reducing the risk of infection. The health benefits of Anthemis rosea subsp. carnea include its ability to alleviate digestive issues, reduce fever, and calm anxiety, while its therapeutic actions involve promoting relaxation, reducing inflammation, and fighting off infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
